text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To be left eating their dust...
How pathetic of me...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Still... if that's the case,
there's only one thing left to do.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hone myself and clear my name—
that is all.

text_block_list.text: I shall swiftly restore things to the way they ought to be.

text_block_list.text: I will clear this humiliation, without fail—!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Bring me a training regimen that will push me to the absolute limit.
